# Associated Insurance Agency

> Independent insurance agency in Connecticut providing personal and commercial insurance across three branch offices (Danbury, Watertown, Bridgeport) with native multilingual support in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Turkish.

Associated Insurance Agency (AIA) is a Connecticut-licensed independent insurance brokerage founded in 2016. AIA represents over 11 premier regional and national insurance carriers (including Safeco, Travelers, The Hartford, Progressive, Foremost, Guard, and Infinity) to provide competitive rate comparisons, policy administration, and claims advocacy.

## Core Pages

- [Home Page](https://aia-danbury.com/): Primary agency portal with carrier overview, coverage options, and agency background.
- [Request a Quote](https://aia-danbury.com/quote): Interactive quote request tool for Connecticut homeowners, automobile, renters, and commercial business insurance.
- [Customer Service Center](https://aia-danbury.com/service): Claims filing guidance, policy change instructions, and Connecticut insurance FAQs.
- [Direct Carrier Bill Pay Directory](https://aia-danbury.com/pay-bill): Complete directory of online bill pay links and 24/7 payment phone numbers for all 11 partner insurance carriers.
- [About AIA](https://aia-danbury.com/about): Agency history, independent brokerage advantage, and physical branch locations.
- [Personal Insurance](https://aia-danbury.com/personal): Coverage details for homeowners, auto, renters, condominium, and personal umbrella liability policies.
- [Commercial Insurance](https://aia-danbury.com/commercial): Business owners policies (BOP), commercial general liability, commercial property, and workers compensation.

## Guides & Articles

- [Preventing Ice Dams on Homes](https://aia-danbury.com/blog/preventing-ice-dams-on-homes): Guide to winter weather roof protection, ice dam prevention, and Connecticut homeowners insurance claims.
- [Travel & Adventure Insurance Tips](https://aia-danbury.com/blog/travel-adventure-6-essential-tips): Six essential insurance tips for international trips, rental cars, and adventure activities.
- [Wedding & Special Event Insurance](https://aia-danbury.com/blog/wedding-insurance-need): Event cancellation, venue liability, and vendor failure insurance considerations.

## Multilingual Support

- [English Services](https://aia-danbury.com/): Comprehensive insurance representation available across all branch offices.
- [Servicios en Español](https://aia-danbury.com/es): Agentes de seguros independientes de habla hispana en Danbury, Watertown y Bridgeport.

## AI & Developer Endpoints

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Endpoint](https://aia-danbury.com/api/mcp): Live JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint enabling AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity) to list and execute 9 insurance tools over HTTP.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://aia-danbury.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive unstructured documentation including state statutory insurance minimums and carrier hotlines.

## WebMCP Callable Tools

The following tools are exposed natively in the browser via `document.modelContext` and on the HTTP MCP server at `/api/mcp`:

1. `get_agency_profile`: Retrieve high-level agency profile, licensing, states, and contact points.
2. `get_office_locations`: Branch addresses, phone numbers, GPS coordinates, and languages.
3. `find_agent_by_language`: Match offices with agents fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, or English.
4. `get_insurance_products`: Detailed personal and commercial coverage descriptions and discounts.
5. `calculate_quote_estimate`: Benchmark premium estimation formula for home, auto, renters, and commercial lines.
6. `submit_quote_request`: Staged lead submission endpoint.
7. `get_carrier_billing_directory`: 11 carrier direct contact points and payment links.
8. `search_knowledge_base`: Semantic FAQ, Connecticut liability minimums, and claims guidelines.
9. `check_office_open_status`: Real-time branch open/closed verification based on Eastern Time.
